Title: [LSJ] Legacy of Power vs Illusions of the Kindred

Messages.Author: Damnans
Messages.Body:
- François Villon blocks Tyler
- Before range is chosen Villon plays an Illusion of the Kindred
- Tyler enters combat with an Illusionary vampire
- ¿Can Villon play a Wake with Evening's Freshness and a
Legacy of Power to send both Tyler and the Illusionary vampire
into torpor?

Greetings,
Damnans

Messages.Author: reyda
Messages.Body:
Damnans wrote:
:: - François Villon blocks Tyler


yes ,he can. This question has already been answered =)
the illusionary vampire burns but the opposing vampire still goes into
torpor.
